title: ToDoPro: Faster and Better Reference-Based Generation: Early Token Reduction via Downsampled Self-Probing
abstract: arXiv:2610.34782v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent generic reference-based image generation models natively support multiple conditions by concatenating all reference image and text tokens into a joint sequence processed by a single Diffusion Transformer (DiT). However, this versatile paradigm comes at an efficiency cost: accommodating multiple references leads to a token explosion, incurring massive $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ computational complexity. Most acceleration methods operate inside the DiT, showing limited capability in reducing spatial redundancy and failing to alleviate peak VRAM. While some pre-model token reduction alternatives exist, they inevitably introduce external models. This raises a question: Is it possible to achieve acceleration and memory savings while preserving compatibility with in-model techniques and requiring no additional parameters? In this work, we realize this goal by proposing the early Token reduction via Downsampled self-Probing (ToDoPro). By execu

translated_title: ToDoPro：更快更好的基于参考的图像生成：通过下采样自探测实现早期Token削减
translated_abstract: 近期的通用基于参考的图像生成模型通过将所有参考图像和文本Token拼接成一个由单一扩散Transformer（DiT）处理的联合序列，从而原生支持多种条件输入。然而，这种通用范式以效率为代价：容纳多个参考图像会导致Token数量爆炸，带来巨大的 $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ 计算复杂度。大多数加速方法在DiT内部运行，在减少空间冗余方面能力有限，且无法缓解显存峰值问题。虽然存在一些模型前置的Token削减方案，但它们不可避免地引入了外部模型。这提出了一个问题：是否可以在保持与模型内部加速技术兼容且不需要额外参数的情况下，实现加速和显存节省？在这项工作中，我们通过提出下采样自探测早期Token削减方法（ToDoPro）实现了这一目标。
tldr: 提出ToDoPro方法，通过下采样自探测在DiT之前进行早期Token削减，在无需额外参数且兼容模型内部加速技术的前提下，显著加速基于参考的图像生成并节省显存。
en_tdlr: ToDoPro performs early token reduction via downsampled self-probing before the DiT, accelerating reference-based image generation and saving VRAM without any additional parameters while remaining compatible with in-model acceleration techniques.
